subject: [PATCH v4 18/21] exfat: convert iomap ops to ->iomap_next()

2026-07-27.patch_summary: This patch converts the iomap operations for the exfat file system to use the new ->iomap_next() callback, which is generated using macros that wrap the iomap_iter_next helper. This change does not introduce any functional changes and only updates the code structure. The conversion is done for both read and write operations.
